name: agrinexus
description: Enterprise agricultural intelligence and farm-to-market traceability platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @agrinexus/api" "npm run dev -w @agrinexus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agrinexus/api && npm run build -w @agrinexus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agrinexus/api && npm run typecheck -w @agrinexus/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @agrinexus/api && npm run lint -w @agrinexus/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @agrinexus/api && npm run test -w @agrinexus/web
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @agrinexus/api && npm run clean -w @agrinexus/web
